 The **Anti-Scorched Training Pistol** is an automatic pistol in *Fallout 76*.

## Gameplay[edit]

The Anti-Scorched Training Pistol is a customized 10mm Pistol given to the player during the quest Into the Fire. It deals 25% more damage to the Scorched, but 20% less damage to all other enemies. Its bullets are made with depleted Ultracite, making the fired shots blue in color.

### Weapon Modifications[edit]

Unlike many other named variants of weapons, this pistol cannot be modified in any way. As a result, weapon skins cannot be applied to this weapon.

¹ Unique version of the Scorched killer's receiver. Sets fire mode to automatic. +10% AP cost. -10% range. -17.52% fire rate.

## Location[edit]

Given to the player character by Bernie, along with a Fire Breather Uniform and Fire Breather Helmet, for reaching the final exam stage of Firebreather training. As with other quest-given items, the pistol's level depends on one's level when receiving it, and it can scale up to level 50 if one is level 50+ when starting the quest.
